article.story: BUFFALO, N.Y. -- — Jake Lemelman had 23 points in Mercyhurst’s 68-65 overtime victory over Western Illinois on Saturday. Lemelman added five assists for the Lakers (2-5). Cameron Johnson scored 21 points while going 9 of 16 from the floor, including 0 for 3 from 3-point range, and 3 for 3 from the line, and added six rebounds. Deraje Agbaosi shot 4 of 11 from the field and 3 of 5 from the free-throw line to finish with 11 points, while adding six rebounds and three steals for Mercyhurst. Tayelor Moore led the Leathernecks (1-6) in scoring, finishing with 12 points. Makai Kvamme added 12 points for Western Illinois. Daivion Traylor finished with 11 points and 12 rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
